artifacts.designs/: not_created — ASCII layouts in design.md plus css/tokens.css are the design contract

key_inputs.data_strategy: hybrid — curated YAML core, Wikidata SPARQL import for breadth, curated always wins on merge
key_inputs.primary_views: zoomable deep-time timeline canvas AND year-slice cross-section
key_inputs.tooling: Python pipeline emitting JSON; site is pure static HTML/CSS/vanilla ES modules
key_inputs.hosting: GitHub Pages via Actions publishing site/

assumptions: Years use historical numbering with no year zero; a single astro()/historical() pair is the only conversion boundary
Deep-time shorthand (ka/Ma/Ga) is relative to 1950 CE per geological BP convention
Generated site/data/ is committed so the site never requires the pipeline at deploy time
Node is a test-time dependency only, via the built-in node:test runner; the site has zero runtime dependencies
ES modules and fetch require http(s); local preview uses python3 -m http.server
First-paint budget is 600 KB gzipped at 20,000 entries
verified_during_planning: Anchored piecewise-log time scale is strictly monotone over ~9000 sampled years spanning 4.54 Ga to the present
Round-trip yearToUnit/unitToYear error is under 1e-5 years at all anchors and probe points
Budget allocation measured: recorded history 48%, Pleistocene 12%, deep time to K-Pg 20%
A naive pure-log scale was prototyped and rejected (recorded history got only 12% of the bar)
Clamping BP at zero would collapse 1950-present to a single point; the +1000 offset is required instead
Python 3.14, Node 20 with node:test, and git 2.50 are available in this environment
save_point_commit_policy: one focused commit per numbered slice, using the commit message named in that slice

groups.p1-frontend: site/js pure modules, ready after slice 1.1
groups.p3-content: data/curated/*.yaml, one file per subagent, ready after Phase 4 validation lands

review_points: end of Phase 1 — scale precision, no-year-zero handling, byte-stable build
end of Phase 2 — no dropped entries, pan smoothness, deep-link stability
end of Phase 3 — spot-check 20 entries against cited sources
end of Phase 4 — PRD criteria 1-6 demonstrable
end of Phase 5 — curated entries survived the merge byte-identical
end of Phase 6 — all nine PRD criteria against the live site
open_risks: Indian chronology is contested; entries must carry wide brackets, a note naming competing positions, and sources rather than picking a side
Wikidata coverage of Indian scriptural and Bhakti chronology is thin; curated data carries that weight
spine.json size at scale is a Phase 6 checkpoint with lane sharding as the named fallback
validation_commands: browser verification at localhost:8000 including the BCE/CE seam
blocking_findings_fixed: Bound.width bypassed astro(), off by one across the era boundary
loader accepted non-mapping items, empty regions, and blank required strings
createView projected in sp-space, making the scale anchors inert
ticks() threw on any sub-year window straddling the BCE/CE seam, halting the render loop
windows spanning BCE to CE produced a ragged tick ladder from a misapplied magnitude cap
view.span counted the non-existent year 0, so the one-year zoom clamp stopped early
main.js rounded the header year onto year 0 with bare Math.round
deferred_findings: Bound accepts an empty explicit display and derives instead - forgiving behaviour is intended
spec_corrections: Time scale contract: views project through yearToUnit (unit space), not raw sp-space
Tick generation: unit-space sampling with magnitude-capped, BP-aware snapping
